rationale: The original entry premise relied on the bounce stalling beneath the $27.20 session VWAP on fading volume, but the 1-minute candles since entry have pushed above VWAP to $27.22 on expanding volume (27.6k and 18.1k shares versus ~9k at entry). With price now reclaiming and holding above VWAP ($27.20) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.15), the bearish setup has failed prior to hitting the hard invalidation at $27.25. Exiting immediately preserves capital rather than waiting for the remaining $0.03 to stop out.
